description: This file provides testing extensions for the CanvasWindowController class, including methods for sanitizing session keys, converting values to JavaScript string literals, handling frames, parsing IP addresses, and checking network relevance, all enclosed within a debug compile-time conditional.

classes.name: CanvasWindowController
classes.description: Extension providing testing methods for session handling, URL string literals, frame storage, and network address parsing.

methods.name: _testSanitizeSessionKey
methods.description: Tests the sanitization of session keys.

methods.name: _testJSStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JavaScript string literal for a given value.

methods.name: _testJSOptionalStringLiteral
methods.description: Returns a JavaScript optional string literal for a given optional value.

methods.name: _testStoredFrameKey
methods.description: Generates the storage key for a frame given a session key.

methods.name: _testStoreAndLoadFrame
methods.description: Stores a frame and then attempts to load it to test persistence.

methods.name: _testParseIPv4
methods.description: Parses a host string as an IPv4 address into four bytes.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkIPv4
methods.description: Determines if an IPv4 address is within local network ranges.

methods.name: _testIsLocalNetworkCanvasURL
methods.description: Checks if a URL points to the local network for Canvas-related URLs.
